title: Verify one EUR item-shop cheat transition against control
changes: Record CH-0324 as verified for one isolated EUR world-map transition, with explicit source-bound arm, disarm and exact seed restoration; retain other entries as unverified.
validation: At the same initial ROM, runtime and state, one Select+Right frame followed by 90 neutral frames reached the Item Shop with CH-0324 armed for the first frame and disarmed afterward; the no-cheat control stayed on the world map. Both screenshots were visually inspected, seed restoration was exact, sessions closed and protected inputs stayed unchanged.

CH-0334 produced no visible change from 7,749 clan funds after one armed frame, 30 neutral frames and a city-menu redraw on that seed; this is a bounded negative observation, not proof about other scenes.
limitations: The graphics control request initially failed after eight reports existed; an unoccluded same-seed control was captured in a separate isolated copy without removing earlier evidence. A first control-copy setup stopped at an existing-path assertion before creating a session, then the path was corrected.

This is one EUR interpreter/Wine scenario, not native Windows, physical controller, device-hook equivalence or verification of other CH entries. A visible resource modifier remains required for DBG2-21.
